title: New information restores a fair exchange

captions.physics: Changing replies as new information appears
captions.energy: Guiding the exchange towards its question

meaning: You can change a disagreement as new information appears and feel fairness by guiding conversation towards its actual question rather than defending the earlier version.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in changing remarks when circumstances or new information turn the conversation. The Chariot in energy supports the wish to restore direction and reach the answer needed. Justice in emotions brings proportion when words do not require you to answer for more than was said. A changing exchange can serve clarity when the new turn becomes a shared subject rather than a race to correct each other.

For example, you disagree about a message and then notice that “not” was missed when reading it. The phrase’s meaning changes, and you return to what was actually promised. **A new fact helps you answer precisely rather than assign blame**. You can recognise why the earlier remark sounded different and move forward without demanding justification for every reaction to the misread text. Fairness comes from matching the answer to new information rather than defeating a mistake.

The disagreement loses direction again if relief at finding the fact becomes a demand to agree immediately with everything else. A corrected word then becomes an argument for an entire position. The Chariot’s constructive direction helps retain the actual question: what changed in the promise, and what answer is needed now? Proportion remains when new information clarifies the exchange without devaluing the possibility of asking something further.
